refinements.name: GUARD_CLASS_VISIBLE_SEPARATION
refinements.source_concept: Presentation distinguishes mechanical verification, semantic assessment and human decision.
invariants: Keep mechanical_guard, semantic_attestation and human_decision visibly distinct with their different powers explicit.
Mechanical evidence cannot be satisfied by semantic review; semantic review cannot manufacture a mechanical fact.
Human approval cannot repair a failed mechanical guard; one passing class cannot silently satisfy another required class.
mandatory_qualification_expectations: Qualification/review material identifies which required guard classes actually hold.
Do not collapse proof into APPROVED, PASS or GREEN where that presentation hides required-class satisfaction.
failure_unresolved_semantics: A missing or failed required class remains unsatisfied despite success or approval in another class.
Presentation ambiguity cannot establish satisfaction of a required guard.

refinements.name: HISTORICAL_RESULT_CURRENT_APPLICABILITY_SEPARATION
refinements.source_concept: Historical recorded result remains separate from currently resolved applicability.
invariants: recorded_result != current_applicability; RECORDED_RESULT=PASS with CURRENT_APPLICABILITY=STALE is representable without rewriting historical PASS.
Current applicability follows the owning contract relevant invalidation dependencies, not one universal identity tuple.
Historical evidence is immutable. STALE can become newly assessed CURRENT only through fresh owner-resolution/reconciliation under a new assessment generation or equivalent current binding.
Timestamps alone never restore applicability. Memory retention and document age are not evidence freshness.
mandatory_qualification_expectations: Resolve relevant candidate/tree, policy/version, implementation, configuration, RuntimeAttempt/lineage, resource/fence/recovery generation, credential/holder/channel, topology/version and evidence-transfer scope dependencies.
Qualify the complete applicability lifecycle below, including owner, guard, side effect, failure, restart and state meaning.
Permit NOT_APPLICABLE only with explicit governed justification for the exact subject/current scope, never merely to close the dossier.
failure_unresolved_semantics: Any required invalidation dependency that moves or becomes uncertain invalidates current applicability.
Failed resolution remains UNRESOLVED; lost current applicability fails closed as STALE/UNRESOLVED, not restored authority.
Preserve historical results; create a fresh assessment rather than editing an old result into validity.
authority_limits: No new subsystem, package, obligation registry or authority owner.

transitions.owner: P09 applicability resolver consuming current owner-issued evidence
transitions.guard: Required obligation definition, proof classes, subject identities, policy/implementation/configuration identities and owner verification resolve without unresolved dependency.
transitions.side_effect: Record a current applicability assessment referencing immutable historical evidence rather than copying its truth.
transitions.restart_semantics: Re-resolve current dependencies; never assume previous process-memory state or restore current authority from it.
transitions.current_terminal_meaning: CURRENT is a revocable derived applicability assessment, not execution authority or a terminal evidence verdict.

transitions.guard: Any required invalidation dependency moves or becomes uncertain.
transitions.side_effect: Preserve historical result and record stale applicability with explicit invalidation reason.
transitions.failure_transition: Fail closed as STALE/UNRESOLVED; never preserve current authority when invalidation or assessment persistence is uncertain.
transitions.restart_semantics: Restore no current applicability unless dependencies re-resolve.
transitions.current_terminal_meaning: STALE is unusable as current applicable proof; historical results remain unchanged.

transitions.owner: P09 applicability resolver consuming fresh owner-issued evidence/reconciliation
transitions.guard: Fresh owner-issued evidence/reconciliation proves applicability under present identities, policies and generations.
transitions.side_effect: Create a fresh applicability assessment under a new generation or equivalent current binding; do not mutate historical result.
transitions.failure_transition: Remain STALE or UNRESOLVED under existing reconciliation semantics; do not reuse an old current assessment.
transitions.restart_semantics: Re-resolve present dependencies; process restart or restored assessment history is not renewed applicability.
transitions.current_terminal_meaning: Newly assessed CURRENT is revocable; the old assessment and immutable evidence remain historical.

transitions.owner: P09 applicability resolver applying frozen/governed applicability rules
transitions.guard: Frozen/governed applicability rules establish non-applicability for the exact subject and current scope.
transitions.side_effect: Record explicit governed justification and the subject/scope/rules it depends on.
transitions.failure_transition: Remain UNRESOLVED when justification is missing, ambiguous, unsupported or merely a model/reviewer preference.
transitions.restart_semantics: Re-resolve governed justification and its dependencies; scope/rule movement or uncertainty requires fresh UNRESOLVED assessment.
transitions.current_terminal_meaning: NOT_APPLICABLE resolves this assessment only within its justified governed scope; it is not PASS, a waiver or authority.

current_terminal_meanings.UNRESOLVED: Required applicability is not established; no qualification satisfaction follows.
current_terminal_meanings.CURRENT: Revocable derived assessment for current owner-verified dependencies; no execution authority.
current_terminal_meanings.STALE: Prior assessment is not usable as current applicability; retain historical result.
current_terminal_meanings.NOT_APPLICABLE: Scoped governed justification, not a passing proof or waiver. Dependency movement/uncertainty requires a new UNRESOLVED assessment.

applicability_lifecycle.additional_reconciliation_rule: If governed justification for NOT_APPLICABLE moves or becomes uncertain, start a new UNRESOLVED assessment and preserve the previous justified assessment as history.
applicability_lifecycle.authority_limit: This lifecycle describes derived applicability within existing P09 responsibilities. It creates no independent runtime authority owner or universal subject identity.
